tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: tshig bdun sgrub thabs zab mo las: mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i dbang bskur bzhugs: :

bde chen lhan cig skyes mar 'dud: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub gang: lhan skyes ye shes dhā ki ma'i: byin rlabs lam du khyer ba ni: bde myur gsang ba'i lam mchog ste: de phyir de don gnyer ba'i bu: mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du: gzhug par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas: dben pa'i gnas su dkyil 'khor bzhengs: dbus su bum pa bcud ldan dang: mtshan ldan bhañjar a mṛ ta: mngar gsum chang dang sbyar bas bkang: me long li khri brdal ba la: chos 'byung sa bon sngags kyis brgyan: sum brtsegs dar dmar lding gur dbub: sku rten sngags byang mar me shel: sgrub gtor zla gam rgyan gyis spras: gri thod kha ṭ+wāṃ ḍā ma ru: rus rgyan brtul zhugs chas rnams bkod: mchod gtor tshogs kyi yo byad gsag: sbyor ba sngon 'gro'i rim pa 'o: sa ma ya: dngos gzhi phrin las gzhung bsrangs la: bskyed dang bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis: nus dang ldan pa'i gding rnyed nas: dam srung nges pa'i slob ma bos: dag pa khrus nas bton byas la: bgegs bskrad srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom: maṇ+ḍal yon 'bul gsol ba gdab: mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug dkyil 'khor gtso: rdo rje slob dpon bdag la dgongs: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag rgyud smin grol mdzad du gsol: lan gsum zhus la spro ba dri: mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di: zab cing gnyan la khe nyen che: mi ldog dam tshig srung nus na: rjes su bzung bya gzhan du min: zhes dris lan du 'di skad gsol: bla ma'i gsung ni rdo rje'i tshig: nam yang 'da' bar mi bzod pas: dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung lags na: dkyil 'khor gnyan por gzhug tu gsol: zhes zhus snod du gyur pa la: skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa yis: rgyud sbyang dam tshig legs par 'bogs: ho: spyi dang khyad par dam tshig las: nam yang 'da' bar ma byed cig: rdo rje bdud rtsi srog gi chu: rtag tu dpang por dran par gyis:

badz+ra sa ma ya a mrita hūm̐: rdo rje mgor bzhag dam chu sbyin: ye shes byin rlabs dbab pa'i phyir: slob mas sgo gsum gnad bcings la: lhan cig skyes ma'i sku ru gsal: slob dpon dgongs pa'i rtsal bskyed de: thugs srog 'od kyi lcags kyu yis: mkha' spyod gnas nas spyan drangs bstim: sngags tshig rol mo rdzas kyis bskul: pheb pa'i rtags byung brtan par bya: de dag 'jug pa'i rim pa 'o: sa ma ya: slob dpon thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: dbang lha nam mkhar spyan drangs te: bum pa'i bdud rtsis dbang bskur bsam: thog mar bum pa spyi bor bzhag: oṃ: snang stong yum gyi bum pa ru: thabs mchog bde chen bcud du 'khyil: zung 'jug ye shes chu rgyun gyis: sgrib dag dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs shog: oṃ dz+nyā na sarba dhā ki nī ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca mi: rgyud dag snang stong lha skur smin: dbang lha slob ma la thim bsam: rjes 'brel sku gzugs spyi bor bzhag: ye shes sku las gnyis pa 'phros: lus thim lha dang dbyer med bsam: oṃ: gsal stong sku yi dkyil 'khor nas: gzi brjid chen po'i byin dbab pas: khyod lus ye shes phyag rgyar gyur: sku yi dbyig tu smin par shog: kā ya badz+ra oṃ: slob dpon dkyil 'khor dbang phyug ma: rang 'od dpa' bor mnyam sbyor ba'i: byang sems bdud rtsi spros par bsam: thod pa'i bdud rtsi lce la bzhag: ā: thabs kyi byang sems bde ba rgyas: shes rab rak+ta chags pa che: zung 'jug lhan skyes bdud rtsi'i bcud: dam tshig chen po dang du longs: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta a hoḥm hā su kha a bhi ṣiñca mi: rjes 'brel bzlas pa'i lung yang sbyin: sngags kyi phreng ba mgrin par bzhag: ā: grags stong gsung gi dkyil 'khor nas: nus pa sngags kyi bcud dbab pas: khyod ngag gzhom med dbyangs su gyur: gsung gi dbyig tu smin par shog: wā ka badz+ra āḥ ngag rlung sngags su smin par bsam:

slob ma pad+ma dpa' bor gyur: sin+dhu'i dal las phyag rgya mo: lhan skyes dhā ki'i ngo bo spros: snyoms zhugs dga' bzhi skyes par bsam: me long dkyil 'khor lag tu gtad: smin mtshams snying gar thig le bkod: hūm̐: chos 'byung las rgya'i chu skyes dbus: yig 'bru chos dang snyoms 'jug gi: dmar 'od dam tshig gtum mo 'bar: gsal stong phyag chen mtshon par byos: oṃ karma mu dra sarba dz+nyā na ma hā su kha a bhi ṣiñca mi: rjes 'brel rdo rje snying gar bzhag: ye shes phyag mtshan spros nas bstim: hūm̐: rig stong thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes dgongs pa'i rtsal 'phos pas: khyod yid 'od gsal chos skur gyur: thugs kyi dbyig tu smin par shog: tsit+ta badz+ra hūm̐: rtog tshogs dbyings su grol bar bsam: rdo rje sems dpa'i me long bstan: dpe nyid tshig gis mtshon bya ste: hrī: ngo bo stong pa lhan skyes yum: rang bzhin gsal ba thabs mchog yab: zung 'jug mdangs rtsal 'khor 'das su: snang yang rang bzhin med par ltos: oṃ dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na badz+ra a a a: rjes 'brel mar me lte bar bzhag: gtso mo'i lte ba'i raṃ dmar las: ye shes me lce tshon gang spros: lte bar thim pas byin brlabs bsam: hrī: bde stong ye shes dkyil 'khor nas: lhan skyes dga' ba'i rlabs g.yos pas: sgo gsum mi 'gyur bde ba che: rdo rje'i dbyig tu smin par shog: dz+nyā na badz+ra hrī: lhan skyes bde stong mngon gyur bsam: brtul zhugs spyod pa'i chas rnams gtad: ho: gzung 'dzin rtsad gcod gri gug 'bar: bde skyong bhan+dha dam tshig snod: thabs shes cang te'u dril bu dang: zungs 'jug rdo rje'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: phar phyin rus pa'i phyag rgya bcas: zung la brtul zhugs ci bder spyod: sa ma ya tsar+ya a bhi ṣiñca mi: mtha' rten yongs rdzogs byin rlabs ni: gtor ma mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor gsal: rdo rje bzhi yi ye shes kyis:

smin cing grol bar byin brlabs bsam: hrī: gtor snod bde chen 'khyil pa'i gzhal med khang: gtor ma sku gsum yum mchog gtso dang 'khor: ye shes gzi byin 'od zer lams se lam: bde stong rol pa'i byin rlabs thibs se thib: dngos grub bdud rtsi'i char rgyun sha ra ra: ma g.yel thugs rje chen po'i rtsal skyed la: skal ldan lus ngag yid gsum smin par mdzod: sgo gsum sgrib pa'i rtsa ba drungs nas phyungs: mi phyed rdo rje bzhi yi dbang mchog skur: tshe dang ye shes mchog gi dngos grub stsol: thabs shes dga' ba bcu drug gsang lam bgrod: 'gyur med lhan skyes ye shes mngon gyur mdzod: snying po'i sngags kyi sham bu ru: ba liṃ ta e waṃ mu dra kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dz+nyā na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: gnas bzhir bzhag la lha yang bstim: gtor zan dngos grub zhal bsror sbyin: gal te brgyud 'dzin dam ldan la: gsang ba'i srung ma mched gsum gyi: bka' gtad byed na gtor ma gsum: lhar gsal slob ma'i lag tu gtad: hrī: lhan skyes ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: sogs nas/ bcas pa rnams: sku gsum bla ma'i spyan snga ru: zhal bzhes g.yar dam ma bsnyel bar: dam tshig ldan pa'i bu 'di la: mi 'bral ma bu lta bur 'grogs: phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med sgrubs: bde chen mchog gi ye shes spel: dngos grub 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod: so so'i sngags kyi sham bu ru: las sngags sbrel te bka' bsgos pas: dgyes bzhin zhal gyis bzhes par bsam: de rnams dbang gi dngos gzhi 'o: sa ma ya: rjes su dam tshig khas blang zhing: yon phul tshogs kyi dga' ston spyad: shis pa brjod cing gtor bskyang sogs: las kyi rim pa mtha' ru dbyung: mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du: smin byed gsang chen gsang ba'i bcud: 'brel tshad mkha' spyod gnas su 'dren: nyams blangs bde chen ye shes 'grub: lam gyi bar chad nges par sel:

phyis 'byung skal ldan gdul bya'i don: thugs kyi thigs pa bcud du 'dril: dgongs klong smon lam rgya yis btab: dus babs lo tsā chen po yi: sprul pas klong lnga'i rgya bkrol nas: snod ldan mang po'i don byed shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pas rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gnas kyi snying po thugs mchog rdo rje'i rdzong tsit+ta gsang ba'i phug par gtan la phab pa'o// //
